name: Yog's Hide
summary: Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage. The price: Speed -10 ft, Dexterity -2, and no feeling in your skin ever again.

source.note: A vestige of the Amber Temple (Curse of Strahd chapter 13 in spirit). The vestige's name is the book's; the gift, its benefit, its price and every word here are ours, designed for this game. Found in amber_temple_faceless_god (the ring of amber).

benefit.text: Your skin goes dense and grey as old horn. Blades skid on it. Clubs bounce.

cost.flaw: You no longer feel warmth or touch. An embrace is a weight on your shoulders and nothing more.
cost.text: You move like something carved: heavily, and a beat behind everyone else.
